rows.title: Film Review: Extreme Job (2019) by Lee Byeong-heon
rows.dek_lead: Saving grace this time comes from South Korea, in the form of Lee Byeong-heon‘s action comedy “Extreme Job” that <strong>works superbly on both levels, being properly tense and funny-to-die, while also adding satire and social insight in it

rows.title: Film review: Extreme Job
rows.dek_lead: Though undeniably slight and silly, Extreme Job is a solid popcorn flick, with enough laughs and thrills to keep the viewer entertained. This to a large extent is down to the efforts and enthusiasm of the top-notch ensemble

rows.title: Review: ‘Extreme Job’ is a Korean comedy in the tradition of ‘Police Academy’
rows.comment: Review: ‘Extreme Job’ is a Korean comedy in the tradition of ‘Police Academy’
